invariants.rationale: If result is non-null, we cannot be in the case where all of clip is true, touchable is true, and getTouchable() is disabled.
If result is non-null, then if clip is true, x and y must be within bounds.

invariants.expression: result == null || (!clip || (x >= 0 && x < getWidth() && y >= 0 && y < getHeight()))
invariants.rationale: If result is non-null, and clip is true, x and y must be inside the container.
If result is null, then either it did not reach the super.hit call or super.hit also returns null.
If clip is false, then the method always delegates to super.hit.
